question: For Thursday's renewal review on 2026-10-15: what termination notice period applies under SA-2026-001 on that date, and since when has it applied?
answer: Under SA-2026-001, as amended by AMD-2026-001, the termination notice period on October 15, 2026, is 60 days [SA-2026-001 §5; AMD-2026-001 §2]. This 60-day notice period has applied since October 1, 2026 [AMD-2026-001 §3].
